title: Freeze after BLE connection reset (DASH)
body:
Hi there,

I’ve been experiencing rare AAPS freezes since upgrading to a 3.3.3dev-based version. The app becomes unresponsive, and I need to force stop it. This has happened only three times in the last 30 days. I'm on AutoISF (A3.3.3.a+aisf3.1.0), but imho this issue is not related to any changes from AutoISF.

I was able to pinpoint the freeze to around 6:15 and found the following log lines. Therefore, I suspect its something about the BLE reset. Full log attached. Just wanted to share my findings with you, hope it helps!

I'm on Android 14, SGS24, Omnipod Dash, FSL3 (via Juggluco)
Build: I'm on the A3.3.3.a+aisf3.1.0 from https://github.com/T-o-b-i-a-s/AndroidAPS/tree/3.3.3.a+aisf3.1.0

